fee_notes: Traditional Inline/End Cap and Free-standing: $15,000-$40,000; Non-traditional: $15,000-$30,000. MUOA: first unit $40,000, additional units $15,000/option. Existing compliant franchisees: $30,000. VetFran 20% discount on initial franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee can range from $15,000 to $40,000 depending on the type of model chosen, and whether the Franchisee has entered into a MUOA.
